description: ignorePaths restates the 8 globs of :ignoreModulesAndTests, because a local ignorePaths replaces the preset's array. Keep all 8 beside any repo-specific entry, and re-check them against the preset before editing.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: CVE-driven bumps skip the before-6am window so security PRs open immediately, and minimumReleaseAge cuts their automerge soak to 1 day. osvVulnerabilityAlerts adds OSV scanning for pinned Docker images, which Dependabot does not cover, and both need repo Dependabot alerts enabled.

lockFileMaintenance.description: pyproject.toml uses unbounded ranges, so Renovate sees nothing to bump while uv.lock stays frozen. A daily lock refresh PR reuses the open one. NO automerge, because a refresh can contain major jumps.

customManagers.description: Reads the release version in each `fetched_url` of the system-upgrade role's vendored manifests (H6.1b), which the annotation on `system_upgrade_controller_version` leaves behind. Same depName as the annotation, so one PR moves both and `vendor_manifest.py --check` names the refresh still owed.
Pinned hook revisions in prek.toml. Renovate's built-in pre-commit manager reads only .pre-commit-config.yaml, so these pins would age silently.
shellcheck-py rev in prek.toml. The repo publishes only 4-component v-prefixed tags, so this manager uses github-tags. The packageRule below groups it with the pyproject.toml twin pin.
Pinned prek version in CI (`pip install prek==X` in .github/actions/setup/action.yml, #3723), tracked on PyPI so it does not age silently.

The Vale binary CI's `hooks` job runs, pinned by version and sha256 in one match. The `vale` tool of hosts/packages/homelab-tools/package.yml is a second copy (#1703), the `{{depName}}` group puts both in one PR, and tests/repo/test_vale_matches_the_ci_pin.py ENFORCES that they agree.

The gitleaks binary the promote workflow's render job downloads. TWO matchStrings, because the URL carries the version in the tag and in each asset name. The `gitleaks (prek.toml and the promote workflow)` packageRule groups it with prek.toml's rev.

The flux CLI release each flux CI job fetches (#7778), pinned as `FLUX_VERSION` and `FLUX_SHA256` in env. depName equals the annotation on `flux_version`, so the `fluxcd/flux2` packageRule puts every pin in one PR. ENFORCED by scripts/tests/test_renovate_flux_cli.py and the `flux-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.

The cosign release that promote.yml, prune-artifacts.yml and flux-deletion-drill.yml fetch (#7781), pinned as `COSIGN_VERSION` and `COSIGN_SHA256` in env. The `sigstore/cosign` packageRule puts all three pins in one manual PR. ENFORCED by scripts/tests/test_renovate_cosign_release.py and the `cosign-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.

The nfpm binary CI's `host_packages` job builds with (H3.3a), pinned by version and sha256 in ONE matchString. The builder on daniel-box uses the nfpm in `hosts/packages/homelab-tools/package.yml`, and `hosts/lib/tests/test_builder_component.py` holds the two equal.

The sops and chezmoi binaries the `homelab-tools` host package ships (H3.11), pinned by version and sha256 per architecture. The `{{depName}}` group puts both architectures in one PR. ENFORCED by scripts/renderer/tests/test_renderer_host_tools.py.

The k3s version `hosts/bootstrap-host.sh` embeds (H7.42), the second copy of `k3s_version`. hosts/lib/tests/test_bootstrap_host_pins.py holds all three k3s values equal, and the `k3s-io/k3s` packageRule groups this bump with the defaults file's.

The kind binary CI's `sops_manifest_type_proof` job builds its cluster with (D3.3d, #5173), pinned by version and sha256. The `kind` packageRule puts it and the node image in one PR, because each kind release lists the node images it built. ENFORCED by the `kind-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.

The kindest/node image CI's `sops_manifest_type_proof` job boots (#5173), pinned by tag and digest. Its Kubernetes minor follows `k3s_version`, which tests/repo/test_kind_node_image_follows_k3s.py holds. ENFORCED by the `kind-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.

The pint binary scripts/validate/alert_tools.sh provisions for the validate-alert-rules hook (M2). `pint_version` is its only pin, and the script checks the tarball against the release's checksums.txt, so a bump needs no checksum edit.

Pinned Vale style package in .vale.ini. A bare `Packages = Google` resolves to the newest release at `vale sync` time, so the pin stops CI rules changing with no commit, and this manager stops the pin ageing.

The dotfiles commit the CI pytest job checks out (`DOTFILES_SHA` in .github/actions/pytest-tools/action.yml, #2812). A pin rather than `main` keeps an unrelated dotfiles commit from turning server CI red, and a person reads each bump's CI run before merging.
The gh-actions-lock extension release the ci.yml `lockfile` job installs with `gh extension install --pin` (#8014), tracked through github-releases.

CI test-runner Python pin (`python-version:` in .github/actions/setup/action.yml, #3733), which helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests does not track. The literal is three-part (#2152) while `.python-version` stays two-part, and tests/repo/test_python_version_consistency.py compares them on major.minor.

CI Node pin (`node-version:` in .github/actions/setup/action.yml, #3724), which feeds only renovate-config-validator. The literal is three-part (`24.21.0`), and a `\d+` matchString would read the major alone and go inert.

karakeep-time-tagger runtime pip deps pinned inside its container command (`uv pip install <pkg>==<ver>`), which would otherwise re-resolve to the newest PyPI release on every start (review M3). The packageRule below keeps bumps manual.

jellyfin-ani-sync plugin release pin in k8s/jellyfin/defaults/main.yml, which the k8s-images manager cannot see because it keys on `_image:`. THREE matchStrings, because the version appears in the release tag, the asset name and `jellyfin_k8s_anisync_version`. NEVER automerged (packageRule below): the targetAbi and MD5 are not computable.

Intro Skipper plugin release pin in k8s/jellyfin/defaults/main.yml, in the ani-sync manager's shape, with THREE matchStrings. Upstream keeps a 10.11 line and a 12.0 line in one repository, so extractVersionTemplate is anchored to `^10\.11/v`, because the 10.11 server rejects a 12.0 plugin silently. RAISE THAT ANCHOR when jellyfin_k8s_image moves to a new Jellyfin minor. The fourth version group is named `build`, not `revision`, because Renovate reads `revision` only when `build` is present, and a rename would silently stop the manager offering updates.

Webhook plugin release pin in k8s/jellyfin/defaults/main.yml (#1557), with TWO matchStrings that capture only the bare major. extractVersionTemplate is the release-line ANCHOR: Webhook 22 declares targetAbi 12.0, which a 10.11 server rejects silently. RAISE IT when jellyfin_k8s_image moves to Jellyfin 12.

Merge Versions plugin release pin in k8s/jellyfin/defaults/main.yml (#1616), with TWO matchStrings. extractVersionTemplate is the release-line ANCHOR and admits only the 10.11 line, because 12.0.0 declares targetAbi 12.0. RAISE IT when jellyfin_k8s_image moves to a new Jellyfin minor. The fourth version group is named `build`, not `revision`, because Renovate reads `revision` only when `build` is present, and a rename would silently stop the manager offering updates.

Media Cleaner plugin release pin in k8s/jellyfin/defaults/main.yml (#1619). The plugin deletes media files, which is why it is pinned at all. TWO matchStrings capture only the three-part release, because the fourth segment of `jellyfin_k8s_mediacleaner_version` encodes the server ABI, which no datasource can supply.

pip pins inside the two built Dockerfiles that install from PyPI (#2149, #2150): k8s/roles/code-server and k8s/roles/homelab-mcp. ical-proxy is not here, because tests/services/test_ical_proxy_pins_match_uv_lock.py holds its pins to uv.lock. The packageRules below keep every bump manual and cap mcp at <2.

The Claude Code CLI the code-server image installs with `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@X.Y.Z` (#2149). The built-in npm manager reads package.json only. The Anthropic.claude-code VSIX in the role's defaults stays at the same release, which is a manual finish.

CodeLLDB, the one code-server extension downloaded from a GitHub release rather than Open VSX. TWO matchStrings cover the `version:` line and the `/download/v<version>/` URL segment. The sha256 is a manual finish: `asset_pins.py --refresh 'code_server_k8s_extensions[vadimcn.vscode-lldb]'`.

The fuzzball package both n8n images install: `npm install -g fuzzball@X.Y.Z` (#2213) and `pnpm add fuzzball@X.Y.Z` (#5391). The built-in npm manager reads package.json only, so one regex manager over both files moves both pins in one PR.

Every pinned version in a role's defaults/main.yml or a host component's component.yml with a `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>` annotation on the line above a `<key>_version:` pin. Adding a pinned artifact is the annotation plus its defaults, with no customManager (#3732). The depTypeTemplate packageRule below makes each bump a manual PR that names `asset_pins.py --refresh <depName>`.

Headlamp plugin release pins in k8s/headlamp/defaults/main.yml. Every plugin lives in one repo, headlamp-k8s/plugins, with tags `<plugin>-<version>`, so extractVersionTemplate keys on the plugin name. NO automerge (packageRule below): the sha256 is not published.

Container images in k8s role defaults, inventory/group_vars/all.yml and hosts/components/registry-gc/defaults/main.yml, the cluster's only update signal. autoReplaceStringTemplate lets a tag-only pin gain an `@sha256` suffix (#2392) and must keep the literal `_image: ` prefix, because Renovate replaces the whole matched span. scripts/tests/test_renovate_managers.py asserts it reproduces every live pin byte for byte.

Container images in the Pi's Compose services (hosts/components/pi-compose/services/*/compose.yaml.j2, H5.11), which the built-in docker-compose manager skips because its pattern ends in `.ya?ml`. scripts/tests/test_renovate_pi_compose_pins.py fails if the match count differs from the `image:` lines per file.

packageRules.description: Bundle minor and patch image bumps into one rolling PR inside the daily before-6am window, with a 7-day soak and CI green before automerge. platformAutomerge is false, because GitHub's auto-merge ignores a ruleset bypass (github/docs#45265). rebaseWhen is conflicted rather than auto (#5587), because auto reruns full CI on every master move. ENFORCED: scripts/tests/test_renovate_automerge_does_not_chase_master.py and the `chased-` rows of scripts/tests/test_renovate_package_rules.py.
packageRules.groupName: container images (non-major)

packageRules.description: One PR per k8s service, overriding the shared non-major group above, so each PR is one bump's landing and one bump's revert.
packageRules.groupName: k8s image {{depName}}

packageRules.description: Version bumps on the k8s plane with no release timestamp (#3370). Renovate's docker datasource returns timestamps only for Docker Hub, so a GHCR, lscr.io or gcr.io bump would sit in Pending Status Checks, and `timestamp-optional` raises it with no age check. An eligible role's bump then automerges on its first run, with `promote`'s verification as its only check. ENFORCED: the `no-timestamp-` rows of scripts/tests/test_renovate_package_rules.py.
CI toolchain and docs-lint pins get one group per `{{depName}}`, because the catch-all container-images rule matches every custom.regex dep and PR #939 titled prek carried only a Vale diff (#980).
packageRules.groupName: {{depName}}

packageRules.description: The two kind pins of CI's `sops_manifest_type_proof` job, in one PR (#5173), because each kind release lists the node images it built. It sits after the `.github/workflows/**` rule, whose `{{depName}}` group would split them.
packageRules.groupName: kind (binary + node image)

packageRules.description: No major or minor update for the kindest/node image (#5173). Its Kubernetes minor follows `k3s_version` (tests/repo/test_kind_node_image_follows_k3s.py), so the person finishing a k3s upgrade moves the image.

The CI runner image (`runs-on: ubuntu-24.04` in every workflow). NO automerge: a workflow-only diff matches no prek hook's `files` regex, so the PR's green run never exercises the hooks that use the image's tools (#2366). Before merging, run `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <branch>`; the `renovate-prs` skill §3 has the commands.
packageRules.groupName: CI runner image (manual — check the preinstalled tools the system hooks assume)

packageRules.description: Workflow steps name actions by full version tag, and `.github/workflows/actions.lock` pins each tag to a commit (#8014), so this rule turns `pinDigests` off for `action` deps only. Reusable-workflow calls (depType `workflow`) keep their digest pin, because the lockfile does not cover them.

Digest bumps on the k8s plane automerge after a 3-day soak, because about half the `*_image` pins sit on a digest and 20 on a mutable tag where only a digest bump can be offered. The denylist (`k8s_autodeploy`) is the safety boundary, and tests/deploy/test_channel_tag_digest_pins_stay_off_autodeploy.py holds the DECIDED marker for channel-tag pins (#1524). pinDigest sits beside digest (#2481), because it changes no content. A digest with no timestamp (GHCR, lscr.io, channel tags) cannot be aged, so `timestamp-optional` raises it unsoaked and `promote`'s verification is its only check (#3368). ENFORCED: the `no-timestamp-` rows of scripts/tests/test_renovate_package_rules.py.

The nginx alpine digests soak 1 day rather than 3 (#2886), because upstream re-pushes about every 3.6 days and each re-push restarts the soak. POSITION is load-bearing both ways: after the digest rule it overrides, and before the denylist rule. `test_soak_constants_match_renovate_json` holds `pending_logic.py:FAST_DIGEST_SOAK_DAYS` equal. ENFORCED: the `nginx-` rows of scripts/tests/test_renovate_package_rules.py.

NO automerge for an image bump in a role declaring `k8s_autodeploy: false` (#1886), because `promote` and Flux apply every merged bump. matchFileNames is the denylist spelled as paths, and tests/deploy/test_renovate_automerge_follows_the_autodeploy_denylist.py asserts the two are equal. registry-gc's defaults copy the registry role's pins (#5827), and group_vars/all.yml holds `crowdsec_k8s_image` (#1936). POSITION is load-bearing: after the rules it overrides, before the per-package manual rules. A per-package groupName carries `k8s_autodeploy: false` where a denied role owns the pin, because the title marker keeps the unattended renovate_agent off it (#1963), and `groupSingleUpdates: true` puts it in a single-dependency title (#2646).
packageRules.groupName: k8s images (manual — k8s_autodeploy: false, so a person merges it through land.sh)

packageRules.description: The denylist marker for a denied role's BASE image (#2117). The rule above never sees a `FROM` pin in a role's templates/Dockerfile*.j2, and those PRs lacked the title marker the unattended renovate_agent reads (#1939). tests/deploy/test_renovate_automerge_follows_the_autodeploy_denylist.py asserts the file list.
packageRules.groupName: k8s base images (manual — k8s_autodeploy: false, so a person merges it through land.sh; promote rebuilds it)

packageRules.description: The edge and DNS images keep one PR per image, because their failure takes down every route or LAN DNS and `probe.py health` cannot see it (#1939). It must follow the denylist rule, and tests/deploy/test_renovate_edge_images_stay_one_per_pr.py holds the package list and position.
packageRules.groupName: k8s image {{depName}} (manual — k8s_autodeploy: false, so a person merges it through land.sh)

packageRules.description: Every Python pin the repo keeps in lockstep, in ONE PR (#5479): the CI setup action, `.python-version`, Dockerfile `FROM python:` tags and the k8s `python:<minor>-alpine` pins (#8532). A PR that bumped only the CI pin stayed red against tests/repo/test_python_version_consistency.py. The group carries `k8s_autodeploy: false` because it owns denied roles' pins. ENFORCED: the `python-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.
packageRules.groupName: python (manual — lockstep: .github/actions/setup/action.yml, .python-version, the Dockerfile python tags and the k8s python image pins; run the suite and image smoke on the new interpreter; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: LinuxServer.io images tag as `<upstream-version>-lsNN` (e.g. 4.0.17.2952-ls312). Regex versioning orders these and rejects non-release tags such as commit hashes and nightlies.
Keep prek.toml hook bumps in their own group, apart from the container-image group. The non-major automerge and 7-day soak already apply; this rule only overrides the group name.
packageRules.groupName: prek hooks

packageRules.description: Disable the general prek.toml manager's github-releases lookup of shellcheck-py, which publishes no releases. The github-tags manager above is the live tracker.

shellcheck-py is pinned twice, in prek.toml (github-tags) and pyproject.toml (pypi), and scripts/tests/test_renovate_managers.py asserts the two move in lockstep. One group means one PR touching both files.
packageRules.groupName: shellcheck-py (lockstep: prek.toml + pyproject.toml)

packageRules.description: Every `# renovate:` annotated pin. Most pair the version with a digest Renovate cannot compute, so NO automerge, and the group name names the command that finishes it: `asset_pins.py --refresh <depName>` (#3732). The `crowdsec-` and `annotated-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py assert that a pin with its own later rule overrides this one.
packageRules.groupName: {{depName}} (manual — finish any paired digest: asset_pins.py --refresh {{depName}})

packageRules.description: node_exporter is pinned twice (#3893): the cluster DaemonSet image and the Pi's host binary in `hosts/packages/homelab-tools/package.yml`, which hosts/tests/test_pi_node_exporter_host_unit.py holds equal. One group means one PR, and it must stay AFTER the annotated-pin and homelab-tools rules. NO automerge, because the Pi's updater installs the host binary. ENFORCED: the `node-exporter-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.
packageRules.groupName: node_exporter (manual — lockstep: cluster image + homelab-tools node-exporter pin; the Pi installs it with its next package version)

packageRules.description: Meilisearch (karakeep's search index) changes its on-disk DB format between MINOR versions and refuses to boot on an old database, so upgrades are manual: snapshot first, then flag or dump/restore. Own PR, no automerge, and outside the non-major group so it cannot block that bundle.
packageRules.groupName: meilisearch (manual upgrade — DB format migration; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: influxdb (scrutiny's TSDB) stays on the 2.x line, because it changes on-disk format across majors and the backup plane does not cover the DB. Major and minor are disabled, and patch bumps within 2.9 still flow.

CrowdSec bouncer Traefik plugin, a WAF component whose bump needs a deliberate traefik redeploy that CI cannot prove loads. Own group, no automerge. The `k8s_autodeploy: false` in the groupName keeps the unattended renovate_agent off the PR, because traefik is a denied role (#1963).
packageRules.groupName: crowdsec bouncer plugin (manual — needs traefik redeploy; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: Flux, the deploy controller (k8s/roles/flux). A `flux_version` bump is unfinished until files/gotk-components.yaml is regenerated at the new release, which Renovate cannot run, and tests/k8s/test_flux_role.py fails a bump that skipped it. Own group, no automerge, with the `k8s_autodeploy: false` marker (#1963). The rule covers every dep named `fluxcd/flux2` (#4822). ENFORCED by the `flux-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.
packageRules.groupName: flux (manual — regenerate files/gotk-components.yaml; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: The Pi's Docker engine packages, one group, NO automerge. Merging moves nothing: the apply is homelab-docker-engine.service, which stops the Pi's Compose project (#1961), so the operator merges and starts the unit from a LAN session. ENFORCED by the `docker-engine-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.
packageRules.groupName: docker engine on the Pi (manual — merge, then start homelab-docker-engine.service; it stops every container)

packageRules.description: k3s control plane (`k3s_version`, H6.1b). NEVER automerged, because merging this pin is the upgrade: the `system-upgrade` role's SUC Plans apply it to both nodes (H6.3c, H6.3d) and restart the only control-plane node. The operator chooses when, following docs/k3s-upgrade.md. The groupName keeps `k8s_autodeploy: false` because `system-upgrade` is denylisted.
packageRules.groupName: k3s control plane (manual — merging is the upgrade: docs/k3s-upgrade.md; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: MetalLB (`k3s_metallb_version`). NEVER automerged, because merging this pin is the upgrade (H1 Open question 6): a bad MetalLB takes the edge and DNS offline together. Merge only through `land.sh --arm-merge --await-merge` on daniel-box, whose pin gate runs `runbook_gates.py metallb-upgrade` and posts `homelab/upgrade-gates`, which promote requires. A UI merge skips the gate, and `land.sh --regate <pr>` re-runs it.
packageRules.groupName: MetalLB (manual — merging is the upgrade: land it through land.sh, which runs the metallb-upgrade gates; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: Longhorn (`k3s_longhorn_version`). NEVER automerged, because merging this pin is the upgrade (H1 Open question 6): Longhorn rewrites the storage layer under every PVC and supports no downgrade. Merge only through `land.sh --arm-merge --await-merge` on daniel-box, whose pin gate runs `runbook_gates.py longhorn-upgrade` (docs/longhorn-upgrade.md) and posts `homelab/upgrade-gates`, which promote requires. A UI merge skips the gate, and `land.sh --regate <pr>` re-runs it. A PR that jumps more than one minor is red by design: take the next minor by hand.
packageRules.groupName: Longhorn (manual — merging is the upgrade: land it through land.sh, which runs the longhorn-upgrade gates; one minor per PR; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: The host forwarder's CoreDNS in hosts/packages/homelab-tools/package.yml. coredns/coredns carries stray tags `v002` to `v011` that Renovate ranked above 1.14.7 and proposed as a PR whose URL 404s (#3087), so the version is held to three components.

No Renovate PR for `coredns_image` (H1-R1-19). The pin must equal the image the bundled k3s manifest names (`test_coredns_image_follows_bundled_manifest.py`), so it moves only with `k3s_version`. Scoped to the docker datasource under k8s/roles, so the `coredns/coredns` release annotation stays tracked.

No Renovate PR for `system_upgrade_controller_image` (H6.1b). The pin carries the tag of the vendored controller manifest, which `k8s/roles/system-upgrade/tests/test_system_upgrade_role.py` holds equal to `system_upgrade_controller_version`.

system-upgrade-controller (`system_upgrade_controller_version`). NEVER automerged, because a bump changes the controller that upgrades k3s on every node. The vendored `files/upstream/` copies and the image digest move by hand in the same PR (`uv run python scripts/dev/vendor_manifest.py system-upgrade`).
packageRules.groupName: system-upgrade-controller (manual — refresh the vendored manifests and the image digest in the same PR; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: k3s stays on the minor whose Kubernetes schemas are vendored under scripts/validate/schemas/kubernetes.io/ (#2367). Raising the cap starts a minor upgrade (docs/k3s-upgrade.md), and test_renovate_k3s_cap_follows_the_schema asserts it.
prBodyNotes: Merging this PR is the k3s upgrade: SUC applies the pin to both nodes and restarts daniel-box, the only control-plane node, so merge only when that restart is acceptable. Before merging, in this PR: set `k3s_install_script_sha256` beside `k3s_version` in `k8s/roles/system-upgrade/defaults/main.yml`, then run `uv run python scripts/validate/refresh_vendored_schemas.py` and commit the schemas it writes — even for a patch release, because `test_vendored_core_schemas_match_the_cluster` compares the full Kubernetes tag. For a new minor, also set `K8S_SCHEMA_VERSION` in `scripts/validate/validate_lib/k8s_schema.py`, raise this cap by one minor, and delete the previous `scripts/validate/schemas/kubernetes.io/v<old minor>/`. Then follow `docs/k3s-upgrade.md` before merging.

packageRules.description: karakeep-time-tagger's pinned runtime pip deps (review M3). karakeep-python-api tracks the digest-pinned karakeep app's API, so a bump wants a deliberate look. Own group, no automerge.
packageRules.groupName: karakeep time-tagger pip deps (manual — track the pinned app; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: code-server's build pins: the venv's pip packages, the Claude Code CLI on npm and the Node.js release (#2149). One group, no automerge, with the `k8s_autodeploy: false` marker that keeps the unattended renovate_agent off the PR (#1963). A node bump finishes with `code_server_k8s_node_sha256`. Every CLI bump (#4584) must also move the `Anthropic.claude-code` entry of `code_server_k8s_extensions`, which Renovate cannot do, and `test_the_cli_is_pinned_to_the_extension_release` fails the PR until someone does. The finish is to set that entry's version and its `linux-x64` URL, then run `uv run python scripts/validate/asset_pins.py --refresh 'code_server_k8s_extensions[Anthropic.claude-code]'`. The group name carries this finish because it reaches the PR title (#4559), so do not rename it.
packageRules.groupName: code-server build pins (manual — built image, move Anthropic.claude-code with the CLI, finish code_server_k8s_node_sha256 on a node bump and asset_pins.py --refresh rust-lang/rust on a rust bump; k8s_autodeploy: false)
prBodyNotes: If this PR bumps `@anthropic-ai/claude-code`, finish the `Anthropic.claude-code` entry of `code_server_k8s_extensions` in `k8s/roles/code-server/defaults/main.yml` in the same PR: set its version and both version strings in its `linux-x64` URL, then run `uv run python scripts/validate/asset_pins.py --refresh 'code_server_k8s_extensions[Anthropic.claude-code]'`, which rewrites the sha256 of the decoded VSIX. Renovate has no datasource for the extension, so `test_the_cli_is_pinned_to_the_extension_release` stays red until both move together.

If this PR bumps `rust-lang/rust`, run `uv run python scripts/validate/asset_pins.py --refresh rust-lang/rust` on this branch. It rewrites `code_server_k8s_rust_sha256` and `code_server_k8s_rust_src_sha256`; until then the image build fails at `sha256sum -c`. Compare each new digest with the `.sha256` file static.rust-lang.org publishes beside the tarball.

If this PR bumps `vadimcn/codelldb`, run `uv run python scripts/validate/asset_pins.py --refresh 'code_server_k8s_extensions[vadimcn.vscode-lldb]'` on this branch, and compare the new sha256 with the asset digest `gh release view v<version> -R vadimcn/codelldb --json assets` lists for codelldb-linux-x64.vsix.

packageRules.description: homelab-mcp's pip pins (#2150). No automerge: homelab-mcp is flux-owned (D5.14), so a merged bump rolls the pod unattended, and a pip bump can break the app at import time, as mcp 2.0.0 did. The role is auto-deploy eligible, so the group has no k8s_autodeploy marker.
packageRules.groupName: homelab-mcp pip deps (manual — built image; promote rebuilds it after merge)

packageRules.description: mcp stays on the 1.x line, because 2.0.0 removed mcp.server.fastmcp, which homelab-mcp's app.py imports. Lift the cap together with an app.py port to 2.x. tests/services/test_homelab_mcp_pins.py asserts this rule and the pin agree (#2150).

n8n and its task runners are pinned twice, in k8s/roles/n8n/templates/Dockerfile.j2 and Dockerfile-runners.j2, and must move in lockstep, because a split fails every Code-node workflow at runtime. One group means one PR. NO automerge: these are built images with `k8s_autodeploy: false`. Both FROMs pin the `stable` channel tag with a digest, so a diff shows no version and PR #1440 proposed a downgrade through nine green checks (#1493). THE MANUAL HALF: resolve each new digest to its `org.opencontainers.image.version` label and append a row to k8s/roles/n8n/base-pin-history.tsv, which scripts/tests/test_renovate_dockerfiles.py requires.
packageRules.groupName: n8n (manual — append each resolved version to base-pin-history.tsv; lockstep: app + task runners; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: fuzzball, the one npm package the n8n image installs (#2213). Its own group, because a base digest bump carries the base-pin-history.tsv finish and a fuzzball bump does not. NO automerge, and the `k8s_autodeploy: false` marker follows the build coupling onto n8n (#1963).
packageRules.groupName: n8n fuzzball (manual — built image; promote rebuilds it after merge; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: One PR per Pi Compose service (H5.11), and no automerge by default, because one bad bump in the automerging catch-all would hold the whole Pi. `timestamp-optional` applies for the reason the k8s digest rule gives (#3368). ENFORCED: the `pi-` and `alloy-` rows of scripts/tests/test_renovate_package_rules.py.
packageRules.groupName: pi image {{depName}}

packageRules.description: Digest bumps to the Pi's Compose images automerge, as an eligible k8s digest bump does (operator ruling 2026-10-29, docs/archive/host/h5-pi-compose.md). A failed compose run fails reconcile, so the Pi's updater holds the Pi and `HostReconcileFailed` pages, and that gate is the check this automerge relies on. The two rules after this one take automerge away from wg-easy and alloy.

The Pi's wg-easy pin never automerges. wg-easy is the remote-access path into the LAN, so a bad image can cut the tunnel the operator would use to fix it, and a v15 bump is a migration. Scoped by file, not package name, so the cluster's wg-easy keeps its own rules (#4011).
packageRules.groupName: pi image wg-easy (manual — a person lands it, then connects a peer from outside the LAN; a v15 bump is a migration, not a redeploy)

packageRules.description: Grafana Alloy is pinned twice, in the Pi's compose file and the cluster DaemonSet (`loki_homelab_k8s_alloy_image`), and the pins move together in one PR. This rule must sit after every rule that sets the cluster pin's groupName, and before the jellyfin plugin rules. No automerge: loki-homelab is denylisted, so the groupName carries the `k8s_autodeploy: false` marker.
packageRules.groupName: grafana/alloy (manual — lockstep: the Pi's compose pin + loki-homelab's DaemonSet; k8s_autodeploy: false)

packageRules.description: jellyfin-ani-sync. NO automerge, and this rule's position is load-bearing: it must stay AFTER the two k8s-plane rules near the top of this array and before the pinDigests rule, because the minor/patch automerge rule already matches the pin and later rules win. The bump is a manual finish: the URL embeds the Jellyfin targetAbi, and the role requires raising jellyfin_k8s_image in the same change.
packageRules.groupName: jellyfin-ani-sync (manual — finish the targetAbi + MD5, raise jellyfin with it)

packageRules.description: Intro Skipper. NO automerge, and this rule's position is load-bearing for the reason the ani-sync rule above records: after the k8s-plane rules and before the pinDigests rule. The bump is a manual finish: the sha256 and target_abi are not computable, and the operator checks the offered version is on the Jellyfin line jellyfin_k8s_image runs.
packageRules.groupName: intro-skipper (manual — finish the sha256 + targetAbi, check the Jellyfin line)

The bump is a manual finish: the md5 and target_abi come from the official manifest at repo.jellyfin.org, and the operator checks the major still targets the Jellyfin line in use.
packageRules.groupName: jellyfin webhook (manual — finish the targetAbi + MD5, check the Jellyfin line)

packageRules.description: Jellyfin Merge Versions plugin (#1616). NO automerge, and this rule's position is load-bearing for the reason the rules above record: after the k8s-plane rules and before the pinDigests rule. The bump is a manual finish: the sha256, _target_abi and _guid are not computable.
packageRules.groupName: jellyfin merge-versions (manual — finish the sha256 + targetAbi, check the Jellyfin line)

The plugin deletes media files, so the operator picks the per-ABI asset the image satisfies and re-verifies the sha256.

packageRules.description: gitleaks is pinned twice: the prek.toml hook rev and the binary the promote workflow downloads. One group moves both, so the bundle scan never runs a different ruleset from the commit hook.
packageRules.groupName: gitleaks (prek.toml and the promote workflow)

packageRules.description: The cosign release that promote.yml, prune-artifacts.yml and flux-deletion-drill.yml fetch (#7781). No automerge, because the cosign version decides the signature format Flux's source-controller verifies, and a bump it cannot verify stops every promotion. ENFORCED by the `cosign-` rows of scripts/tests/_renovate_rule_rows.py.
packageRules.groupName: cosign (manual — check that Flux source-controller verifies signatures made by the new release)

packageRules.description: Headlamp plugins (#5221): NO automerge, positioned after the k8s-plane rules and before the pinDigests rule, which must stay last. The fetch-plugins init container refuses a tarball until the operator records the new sha256, so an automerged bump would deploy a pod that never starts.
packageRules.groupName: headlamp plugins (manual — record the new sha256)

packageRules.description: The renderer's dependency closure (jinja2, pyyaml, markupsafe) never automerges (R4 Open question 12), because a bump that moves rendered output needs a human to read the render-diff job's diff. It sits after every automerge rule. ENFORCED: scripts/tests/test_renovate_renderer_closure_no_automerge.py.

Turn `pinDigests` back on for the k8s-images and Pi Compose managers' container pins (#3281), because Renovate's regex custom manager ships `pinDigests: false`. groupSlug and group.commitMessageTopic are load-bearing: the built-in `pinDigest` config would put eight services on one branch. POSITION is load-bearing: this rule must stay LAST. It sets neither automerge nor groupName.
